column1: # 8): preview_fit_runner in tools/selftest.sh builds a small Hugo site with
# the real card partials, data/ (canvas height set to the row's height),
# the base image and the fonts, one record per row, and needs the template
# draw the same lines with the same alt, the name size and line count of
# the expect column (0 = the site card). Columns: name, section, canvas
# height, the record's params as TOML key = value pairs split by " | "
# (added to a report's name_type company, state front, one report, reviewed
# 2026-11-01, or a campaign's first and last seen dates), expect. A word
# wider than a line at every name size gets the site card (in-word-break,
# single-token): no break inside a word (fix round 1 of #44 PR 3).
